{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Apprentice}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Darth_Maul_SWDA.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], Sith apprentice of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].]]
{{Quote|I wanted to see the true power of the dark side. Can you teach me to&hellip;''"<br />"''You will learn.|[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]] apprentices herself to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="rot">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
A '''Sith apprentice''' was an individual (occasionally a child) that began serious [[Sith training|training]] under a [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], usually chosen by the Master themselves, after the potential apprentice displayed an impressive act of loyalty or cruelty. In some cases, the individual pledged themselves to the teachings of the Sith Master, thereby becoming the apprentice. In other situations, the Master sought out the student, being guided by the will of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Sith apprentices were analogous to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], and the relationship between Sith Master and apprentice was the analog to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and Padawan. A Sith apprentice's time as a student ended either with his or her death, or when the apprentice killed the master, taking on an apprentice of his or her own, thereby ascending to the rank of Sith Master.

==Role==
{{Quote|Do I need to explain to you again what your duty is? It is to serve the Emperor, through me, his instrument. When you defy me, you defy him.|[[Darth Chratis]] to his apprentice, [[Eldon Ax]]|<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>}}
The role of a Sith apprentice was different from that of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]]. While a Padawan often accompanied their Master on whatever missions they partook, Sith Masters often sent their apprentices on missions alone. The Sith apprentice acted as an agent of the Master, doing their bidding and carrying out their will without question. It was not uncommon for the apprentice to face death, and even succumb to it while carrying out their Master's orders. In addition, a Jedi Padawan was taught by the master, whereas one studying under a Sith Master was to learn all they could from them; teaching was not necessarily the Master's responsibility.

While Sith apprentices were always under the direction of their Masters, oftentimes they were allowed to pursue or birth their own schemes and machinations, further preparing them to successfully assume the rank of Sith Master themselves.

===Training===
{{Main|Sith training}}

Sith apprentice training was both similar to and different from [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]. Sith apprentices learned from their Master's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|technique]], and the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]: specifically the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and how to harness it. Sith apprentices were taught to staunchly adhere to the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith code]].

When [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] established the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], he declared himself the one and only [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]],<ref name="rot" /> but by the time of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the Sith apprentice<ref name="Rise">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> and the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] both held the title simultaneously,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> unlike the earlier tradition of a sole Dark Lord<ref name="totj2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref> (although it appeared that the apprentice did not assume the role of Dark Lord until their training was complete).<ref name="DSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>
